notes: The NP2000US is the North American SKU of Vivitek's NovoPro NP2000 wireless presentation/collaboration gateway (a small desktop puck, not a projector despite the "Vivitek" association with projectors). Confirmed via the official NovoConnect (a Delta Group / Vivitek brand) spec-sheet PDF and corroborated by B&H's retailer spec table, which both list identical port sets: HDMI-Out x1, Ethernet RJ45, USB Type-A x1, MicroSD card slot, and MicroUSB Power-In. A MicroSD card slot is also present (storage expansion) but is omitted here as it is not a signal or power connector per the requested scope. Desktop unit (120 x 75 x 16 mm, 128g) — not rack-mountable, so rackUnits is omitted. HDMI grade inferred as hdmi-1.4 class from the stated max resolution/frame rate (1080p60); the spec sheet does not explicitly state an HDMI version number. Ethernet grade of 100M is from B&H's retailer spec table (10/100 Mbps); the manufacturer sheet just says "Ethernet RJ45" without speed. No grade set for USB Type-A since neither source states a USB version.

ports.name: HDMI Out
ports.note: Max output 1920x1080 (FullHD) at 60fps; bandwidth consistent with HDMI 1.4 class, not explicitly stated as a version in the spec sheet.

ports.name: Ethernet
ports.note: B&H retailer spec lists LAN as 10/100 Mbps.

ports.name: USB Type A
ports.note: Grade/version not specified in either source; likely USB 2.0 given the device class, but not confirmed so grade omitted.

ports.name: MicroUSB Power-In
ports.note: This is the device's DC power input (fed by an external AC adapter rated 100-240VAC in / 5V 2A out), not a USB data port. Labeled 'MicroUSB Power-In' on both the Vivitek/NovoConnect spec sheet and B&H's spec table.
